tasks.short: Prepare clinical rooms, instruments and supplies

steps.what: Inspect rooms, sterile instruments, equipment and supplies against the planned care requirements
outputs: verified preparation needs and stock gaps

steps.what: Prepare rooms, instruments and equipment and replenish supplies or escalate unavailable stock
inputs: verified preparation needs and stock gaps
outputs: prepared room instruments equipment and supplies
recorded unresolved readiness or stock issue

tasks.design: Retain physical readiness checks and preparation with the nurse using existing procedures {DOCS} and stock records {OTHER}. No automatic sterility assessment, stock feed or extra requisition baseline is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readiness must be established physically and supplies must actually be replenished.
tasks.enabler_now: Current procedures and stock channels support this unchanged work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise unsuitable equipment, compromised supplies and incomplete preparation.
tasks.human_edge: Check the real care environment and resolve readiness concerns.
tasks.altitude: Reliable care readiness remains the task.

reach.task: Resolve unavailable supplies and readiness issues
reach.learn: Which gaps need escalation before care

evidence.claim: Documentation tools do not establish reduced physical clinical preparation time.

assumptions: The care team supplies planned requirements and clinical governance supplies approved procedures through existing processes.
The nurse produces readiness and stock observations in s1 and captures unresolved issues during s2; all capture and physical work remain.
No free par level, sterility flag or new stock integration is assumed.
Supply purchasing and sterilisation processing by other staff remain outside this preparation task; no new upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which readiness gaps most often require physical rechecking or replenishment?

already_counted.description: Inspection, preparation and stock handling remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new preparation system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work yield zero saving. No physical readiness work is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide or arrange personnel and student instruction

steps.what: Assess auxiliary personnel or student learning needs and select appropriate approved instruction
outputs: agreed instruction needs and suitable learning option

steps.what: Arrange training sessions, enrol learners and confirm practical attendance arrangements
inputs: agreed instruction needs and suitable learning option
outputs: confirmed learner enrolment and attendance arrangements

steps.what: Provide instruction or supervised practice and check learner understanding and further support needs
inputs: agreed instruction needs and suitable learning option
confirmed learner enrolment and attendance arrangements

tasks.design: Use native session enrolment in {LMS} and calendar invitations {CALENDAR} for routine arrangements. The nurse retains needs assessment, session selection, attendance constraints and practical teaching using approved resources {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine session details may be retyped across invitations and enrolment lists.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing learning system can reuse session details without generating clinical teaching content or assessing competence.
tasks.still_hard: Match instruction to observed learning needs and arrange safe supervision around care work.
tasks.human_edge: Demonstrate practice, notice misunderstanding and adapt feedback.
tasks.altitude: Less routine enrolment administration with preserved practical teaching.

reach.task: Maintain session details and resolve attendance conflicts
reach.learn: Which practical constraints prevent useful participation

evidence.claim: Native session enrolment is an E1 workflow proposal; no measured nursing training arrangement case is supplied.

assumptions: The nurse produces learning needs in s1; all observation and clarification remain counted.

The training coordinator produces approved session identifiers, content version, time, location, capacity and instructor during existing course administration; rollout checks and ongoing upkeep are counted below.
The nurse verifies learner identity and captures availability and enrolment in retained s2 time; no free structured attendance constraints or automatic competence score is assumed.
Use current native enrolment first; unsupported sessions or complex release-from-duty arrangements retain manual coordination with no saving.
Learner and instructor time remains unchanged outside the focal baseline; this task does not claim shorter teaching.
unknowns: Existing learning system features and routine arrangement share
research_questions: Does native enrolment reduce duplicate scheduling entry after attendance and care-cover checks?

already_counted.description: Needs assessment and practical teaching remain fully counted.
Learner and arrangement verification remains counted.

incremental.description: Nurse reports enrolment and invitation mismatches.
Training coordinator checks session metadata and enrolment configuration changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=25+10+55=90; gross 10 less 1 focal upkeep gives net 9. High requires currently duplicated routine session entry; low covers existing automation or complex attendance arrangements. Teaching retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine and treat patients during emergency transport or disaster triage

steps.what: Perform physical examinations and assess patient condition in transport or at disaster triage centers
outputs: current examination findings and immediate concerns

steps.what: Make tentative diagnoses within scope, treat patients and communicate emergency care findings to receiving professionals
inputs: current examination findings and immediate concerns
outputs: delivered emergency care and communicated findings

tasks.design: Keep examination, tentative assessment and emergency treatment with the appropriately authorised nurse, using existing emergency equipment and records {OTHER}. No automatic triage, generated diagnosis or new care recommendation is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work requires physical examination and immediate context-sensitive care.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing emergency resources support this unchanged task; documentation products do not remove examination or treatment.
tasks.still_hard: Respond to rapidly changing conditions and incomplete information in constrained settings.
tasks.human_edge: Assess the person and adapt care while communicating uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Preserve direct emergency assessment and treatment responsibility.

reach.learn: Which context supports continuity during handoff

evidence.claim: Clinical scribe and specialised imaging capabilities do not establish savings in emergency physical examination and treatment.

assumptions: The task applies only to nurses with the relevant emergency role, scope and local authority.
The nurse produces examination findings in s1 and care and handoff information in s2; all physical work and capture time remain.
Other responders produce any existing observations through their own care work; no free structured triage flag or new device feed is assumed.
Existing equipment and protocols remain; no new model or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Emergency role, authority and care setting
research_questions: Which current handoff gaps require clarification by the receiving team?

already_counted.description: Examination, assessment, care and handoff remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new emergency decision system or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work yield zero saving. No emergency care or handoff time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult institutions and associations on nursing concerns

steps.what: Clarify nursing practice concerns and review relevant institutional or association material
outputs: clarified consultation issues and supporting context

steps.what: Consult institutions or associations about nursing practice issues and clarify conclusions and follow-up
inputs: clarified consultation issues and supporting context
outputs: consultation conclusions and agreed follow-up questions

tasks.design: Retain professional consultation, using existing supporting documents {DOCS} and correspondence {EMAIL}. No model represents the nurse or invents an institutional position or recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Concerns require interpretation and a real exchange with responsible representatives.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication channels support this work without a new model.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish local practice concerns from broader professional issues and agree useful follow-up.
tasks.human_edge: Bring grounded experience and understand the representative's position.

reach.task: Clarify professional practice concerns and next steps
reach.learn: Which nursing experiences inform wider practice guidance

evidence.claim: Documentation drafting does not establish reduced professional consultation and relationship work.

assumptions: The nurse elicits and captures the issue in s1, with all preparation time retained.
Institutions and associations produce their existing material and responses; no free structured policy answer or new research feed is assumed.
All consultation, clarification and follow-up capture remain in s2; the representative's time is unchanged outside the focal baseline.
No new consultation system or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Typical consultation scope and authority to speak for an institution
research_questions: Which consultation issues require repeated clarification before useful follow-up can be agreed?

already_counted.description: Preparation and consultation remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new research or consultation tool maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and zero incremental work yield zero saving. No invented correspondence or relationship reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain clinical preparation, emergency work and consultation while simplifying genuine routine training arrangements.
reach: Resolve stock gaps with unit coordination
Share emergency findings with receiving professionals
role.ambitious_version: A nurse who keeps physical and professional work accountable and uses existing tools for routine session administration.
